title: A clearer, livelier lobby
summary: Game selectors now explain which lobby is filling, Skyblock is easier to find while waiting, and Four Corners returns with its complete scenery.
body:
- Each minigame selector shows the next lobby's fill count and its live countdown when a match is about to start.
- A subtle nearby chime helps you notice when somebody is already waiting for a mode, while a separate arrival sound announces new players.
- When the main lobby is quiet, a short trail points toward the Skyblock bee and explains that Skyblock can be played solo.
- Four Corners has been restored from its newer build with the missing scenery and patterns.
- Falling from the Pitchout or BedWars waiting area now returns you safely instead of leaving you below the map.
- /feedback now reaches the team even when no dedicated feedback channel is configured.
- Trusted creative builders can repair the main lobby while its protections remain active for everyone else.
